# EOS-CG phase state

`eos.eos_cg_phase`

## Source

**Gernert, J.; Span, R. (2016)**

The 28-component EOS-CG Helmholtz mixture, evaluated in the reduced variables tau = Tr/T and delta = D/Dr with the reducing parameters composition-averaged over binary interaction parameters and a pairwise departure contribution.


## Algorithm

A model rather than a calculation: what this page pins down is the procedure,
not an equation, and both implementations read it from here.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Scheme | `log_volume_newton` |
| Convergence | `absolute` |
| Tolerance | `1e-07` |
| Max iterations | `50` |
| Initialisation | `ideal_gas` |

## Inputs

| Name | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `components` | - | the EOS-CG component names, mapped to the model's fixed 28-component order |
| `T` | K | absolute temperature |
| `P` | Pa | absolute pressure |
| `z` | dimensionless | the mixture's mole fractions, one per component, summing to one |


## Outputs

| Name | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `z_factor` | dimensionless | the compressibility factor `Z = P v/(R T)` |
| `u` | J/mol | the internal energy |
| `h` | J/mol | the enthalpy |
| `s` | J/(mol*K) | the entropy |
| `cv` | J/(mol*K) | the isochoric heat capacity |
| `cp` | J/(mol*K) | the isobaric heat capacity |
| `g` | J/mol | the Gibbs energy, `h - T s` |

| Bound | On violation | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `T > 0` | raises | an absolute temperature; zero and below are not states |
| `P > 0` | raises | an absolute pressure; zero and below are not states |

## Assumptions

- the equation of state is the EOS-CG multi-fluid Helmholtz model of Gernert et al., as NeqSim's `thermo.util.gerg.EOSCGModel` carries it: composition-averaged reducing parameters, an ideal and a residual Helmholtz part, and a pairwise departure contribution.
- the density solve is the logarithmic-volume Newton iteration of the reference implementation, from the ideal-gas guess; the returned root is the gas-like one at the given pressure.
- the component names are the EOS-CG set (`methane`, `nitrogen`, `CO2`, `ethane`, ... `MDEA`), mapped to the model's fixed component order rather than resolved against the general databank.
- the coefficients are vendored verbatim from NeqSim's `EOSCGModel.setup()`, not transcribed by hand.
